verdict.rationale: Background automation, such as scheduled or watch-folder processing jobs, is a fair question for a media-processing tool, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows FFmpeg as a one-off CLI or library invoked by the user. Community reports of batch-file wrappers and a scanner-transcription pipeline are user-side workarounds built around FFmpeg, not a scheduling or automation feature of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
